changeBrief: The local change set strengthens hosted CI's full-suite execution contract, adds shared local-versus-hosted native-tool gates, expands regression tests across resume, OCR, SPDX, release, and length behavior, and documents integration skip semantics.

changeScope.evidence: Nine source/workflow/test/documentation files are in review scope; generated .copilot-tracking artifacts are excluded.

pathCriticality.evidence: The CI workflow and repository contract validator affect validation enforcement; no authentication, persistence, or production application code is changed.

history.evidence: There are no commits ahead of the merge base; the target consists of local uncommitted changes.

testPresence.evidence: The change adds tests for the CI contract, fixture gates, parser/input boundaries, output parity, and integration errors.

coverage.evidence: No coverage report for the changed behavior was available.

rollback.evidence: Changes are reversible workflow, validator, test, and documentation edits; no data migrations or irreversible operations are introduced.
